{{Quote|Captain, an unidentified vessel approaches.''"<br />"''More detail, Lieutenant. Your description does me no help!|The battle droid Lieutenant and the Neimoidian Captain|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
An '''OOM command battle droid''' served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], aboard a [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] under the command of a [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian Captain]]. Around the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] was patrolling near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], when the Lieutenant spotted a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]], [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|piloted]] by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], approaching the planet. The [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|command droid]] Lieutenant informed the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] about the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] ordered the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to [[Battle of Florrum|fire upon]] the Weequay vessel. Soon, the Lieutenant noticed that [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had arrived at the battle zone and reported to the Captain, who sent many [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to destroy the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]. However, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] were defeated by the Republic forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's a small Weequay ship, ''Flarestar''-class.''"<br />"''That sounds familiar. Lieutenant, pull up the threat files for this sector!|The battle droid Lieutenant and the Neimoidian Captain|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
[[File:LieutenantAndCaptain-TCWHtHp1.png|thumb|left|300px|The Lieutenant reports to the Captain.]]
Built by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="db" /> an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was the subordinate of a [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian Captain]], stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]] of a [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|''Munificent''-class star frigate]].<ref name="Hunting" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] was patrolling near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], in<ref name="Hunting" /> the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], when a [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] approached the planet. The [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|vessel]] belonged to the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], who was en route to Florrum to hide himself from the authorities of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Hunting" /> due to his involvement in the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]].<ref name="Hostage">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> When the Lieutenant reported the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] arrival to the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], he ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to bring him the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] threat files. The Lieutenant delivered a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing the files to the Captain, who then verified that the [[Head of State/Legends|Confederate leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had been [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|briefly captured]] by a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Weequay pirate gang]] based on Florrum. Mistaking Alama for one of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the Neimoidian ordered the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to [[Battle of Florrum|attack]] Alama's ship to avenge the [[Count/Legends|Count's]] captivity.<ref name="Hunting" />

The attacking frigate and its target were noticed by<ref name="Hunting" /> a Republic [[Aayla Secura's Acclamator-class assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]],<ref name="Gunship">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/gunship|text=Gunship Over Florrum|int=Gunship Over Florrum}}</ref> which was on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission in the same sector. The Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|ship]] was commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who sent [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]], nicknamed "Bly," with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to investigate the battle, ordering the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] not to engage the Separatists unless fired upon first. The Confederate frigate spotted one of the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], and the Lieutenant proceeded to notify the enemy's movement to the Neimoidian Captain, who ordered [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]<ref name="Hunting" /> of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]]<ref name="Gunship" /> to assault the Republic forces.<ref name="Hunting" /> However, Bly's gunship defeated the droid squadrons, which also shot down Alama's ship, winning the battle for the Republic.<ref name="Gunship" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Since you're all droids, you need not share in the rewards that will inevitably await my success!''"<br />"''Roger roger.|The Captain and the Lieutenant|<ref name="Hunting" />}}
The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] Lieutenant had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and,<ref name="Hunting" /> like all OOM command battle droids of the same [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|series]], stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="db" /> Second-in-command of a ''Munificent''-class [[Star/Legends|star]] frigate, the droid Lieutenant served the ship's Neimoidian Captain, overseeing the patrolling frigate's operations and reporting all detected activity in the sector to the superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. The Lieutenant's reporting style did not come without negative commentary, as the droid's poorly detailed notification about Alama's craft caused the Neimoidian to reprove the droid and demand a more thorough briefing. The command droid followed the Captain's orders in a dutiful manner, and when the Captain stated that the droids would not need a share of the reward he would receive for two glorious victories over the enemies of the Confederacy, the Lieutenant promptly agreed.<ref name="Hunting" />

==Behind the scenes==
The OOM command battle droid lieutenant first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], taking place between [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Seasons One]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Hunting" />
